security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG implements IME floating-point matrix multiply-accumulate (e.g., vfmaccvv) and applies the CSR frm rounding mode to the intermediate partial sum S during multi-group accumulation, instead of round-to-odd (rto) as mandated: C_{m,n} ← round_frm(C_{m,n} + round_rto(S)). This causes the emulated result to diverge from hardware-visible behavior when G > 1 (multiple partial-sum groups) and the inner rto rounding is performed.
security_spec.summary: IME spec now mandates round-to-odd for optional intermediate partial sum rounding (inner step), distinct from frm-based accumulation rounding (outer step); QEMU TCG must not reuse frm for both rounding stages or numerical results will be bit-incorrect vs. hardware

location.file_path: N/A (IME not implemented in this QEMU codebase)

findings.finding: IME (Integrated Matrix Extension) is not implemented in this QEMU codebase. No IME-specific decode patterns, TCG translation handlers, helpers, or CPU state fields exist. The violation condition — 'TCG implements IME floating-point matrix multiply-accumulate and applies CSR frm rounding mode to intermediate partial sum instead of round-to-odd' — cannot be triggered because the IME feature is absent. The existing V-extension vfmacc helpers (vector_helper.c:3490-3536) use floatN_muladd() with single-rounding per the V-extension spec, which is correct for the V-extension but would need restructuring (multi-group accumulation with round-to-odd intermediate rounding) if IME were added in the future.

spec_citations.excerpt:
== Matrix Extensions

This chapter is a placeholder for forthcoming matrix extensions.

This section defines the RISC-V Bulk Normalization Algorithm (RVBNA), a scheme employed by multiple RISC-V extensions for efficient computation of floating-point dot products... Aligned products are rounded to an intermediate precision according to round-to-odd (RTO), then summed.
